title: Rocket Exploding into Three Pieces
body: A 200-kg rocket in deep space moves with a velocity of $$(121\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(38.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$. $$Suddenly$$, $$it$$ $$explodes$$ $$into$$ $$three$$ $$pieces$$, $$with$$ $$the$$ $$first$$ $$(\$\$78\, \text{kg}\$\$)$$ $$moving$$ $$at$$ $$-(321\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(228\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$ and the second ($$56\,\text{kg}$$) moving at $$(16.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}-(88.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$.
